name: Jon the Plumber
description:
Jon The Plumber is a family-owned and operated residential service plumbing company proudly based in the city of Buffalo. Serving Western New York since 2013, we specialize in reliable, code-compliant plumbing solutions for homeowners and builders alike.
Our services include residential plumbing, sewer and water line excavations, bubbler line installations, sump pump and water-powered backup sump pump installations, hot water tank and tankless water heater installations, and plumbing work required for the sale of a home. We also provide professional drain snaking, high-pressure water jetting, and visual sewer camera inspections.
Fully licensed and insured, we take pride in delivering high-quality, clean work with attention to detail.
